project.name: vulnjava
project.description: Deliberately vulnerable Java library used to validate a Jazzer/ClusterFuzz pipeline before onboarding a real project. Mirrors the vulnfuzz C benchmark: a difficulty ladder of intentional bugs, none of which reference Jazzer -- this jar is exactly what a real production module (e.g. MOSIP's id-repository) would look like from the fuzz harness's point of view.
